A defect in the existing control plane becomes an **in-scope bootstrap repair task** for the affected operation, not a reason to abandon the migration or create another approval system. Preserve task identity, source SHA, logs and work artifacts through restart/disconnect; no silent success claims. The new autonomous implementer becomes the primary authority only after it has completed real development tasks and recovery/rollback tests; user-visible traffic switches selectively, with the old tool retained as fallback until stable.
